name: zvid_pack_color_rgb
description: zVid_PackColorRGB masks and shifts 8-bit RGB components into the active framebuffer pixel format using the global pixel-pack parameters.
known_limits: Covered as part of the zVideo pixel-pack smoke alongside float packing and clear-color state.

After recovering zVid_PackColorRGB as a VC5-era fastcall byte-channel contract for red/green with explicit low-byte blue consumption and direct mask/shift return expression, VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for @zVid_PackColorRGB@12 at 0x4a6cf0 still fails: 69 unmasked mismatches, 20 relocation bytes masked, 6 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, Binary Ninja body is 71 bytes and the VC object symbol is 96 bytes. Remaining tier S drift is the callee body's register-argument homing and zero-extension order around red/green/blue channel packing. A probe that widened red/green to 32-bit parameters improved this standalone compare to 49 unmasked mismatches but broke the already tier-S zFMV_ActionFade constructor call shape, so it was reverted.
